steps.label: Paket pruefen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && cat pz3_aa pz3_ab > pz3.tgz && [ "$(md5 -q pz3.tgz)" = 15b87b6e473ca7d40c749ec792eb8ce6 ] && mv pz/bundle/public pzpub && rm -rf pz && mkdir pz && tar xzf pz3.tgz -C pz && mv pzpub pz/bundle/public && ls pz/bundle/public | wc -l

steps.label: Video rendern
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && s=$(date +%s) && npx remotion render pz/bundle P pz_out3.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error && e=$(date +%s) && echo "render_seconds $((e-s))" > pz_time3.txt

steps.label: Ton und Vorschau
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i pz_out3.mp4 -i pz/mix.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest ponzi_film3.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i ponzi_film3.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 27 -preset veryfast -vf scale=1280:-2 -c:a copy ponzi_film3_vorschau.mp4 && tar czf pz3v.tgz ponzi_film3_vorschau.mp4 && ls -la ponzi_film3*.mp4 >> pz_time3.txt
